actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then iwctl device list | awk "/station/ {print \$2}" | xargs -I{} iwctl device {} set-property Powered on; else iwctl device list | awk "/station/ {print \$2}" | xargs -I{} iwctl device {} set-property Powered off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(nmcli radio wifi) == "enabled" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then bluetoothctl power on; else bluetoothctl power off; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then pactl set-sink-mute @DEFAULT_SINK@ false; else pactl set-sink-mute @DEFAULT_SINK@ true; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pactl get-sink-mute @DEFAULT_SINK@ | grep -q yes && echo false || echo true'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" = true ]; then pactl set-source-mute @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ false; else pactl set-source-mute @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ true; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pactl get-source-mute @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ | grep -q yes && echo false || echo true'
